{{Top|leg}}
'''Holdout Team''' was the infiltration group led by [[Cartann Ground Champion]] [[Cheriss ke Hanadi]] during the [[Adumari Civil War]] that occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. The team successfully captured the [[perator]] of [[Cartann]], [[Pekaelic ke Teldan]], as well as finding the captured [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit [[Red Flight]].<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
